title: Calendar0: AI Calendar for Google, Outlook and iCloud
excerpt: Schedule in seconds and remember every call. See Google, Outlook and iCloud in one week, add meetings in one line, get booked with one link, and get notes from the calls you record. On the web, Mac, Windows and Linux.
content_html:
Schedule in seconds. Remember every call.

The calendar that books your meetings and takes notes on your calls

For founders and managers with a work calendar, a personal one and back-to-back calls. See Google, Outlook and iCloud in one week, add a meeting in one line, and get notes from every call you record in the desktop app.

Free plan, no card needed. Works in your browser, or download the app for Mac, Windows and Linux.

Works withGoogle CalendarOutlookiCloud

You spend your day on calendar admin, one small chore at a time

None of it is hard, and none of it is your fault. Your calendars sit in separate apps, so the checking, the typing and the chasing fall to you.

  1. 8:52 AM

    Are you free Thursday at 2?

    You check your work calendar, then your personal one, then reply.

  2. 11:30 AM

    When works for you next week?

    Five emails later, you both settle on Tuesday.

  3. 1:15 PM

    Lunch with Marco, tomorrow

    Title, date, start, end, place, guest. Six fields for one lunch.

  4. 2:58 PM

    Your 3:00 call is about to start

    You search your inbox for the link and join late.

  5. 4:40 PM

    What did we agree on the call?

    Nobody wrote it down, so you ask again.

It isn't just you.

  • 43%

    of workers surveyed spend at least three hours a week just scheduling meetings.

    Calendly, The State of Meetings 2024: 1,244 US and UK workers

  • 57%

    of workers surveyed say it's hard to catch up when they join a meeting late.

    Microsoft, Work Trend Index 2023: 31,000 workers in 31 countries

  • 55%

    of workers surveyed say the next steps at the end of a meeting are unclear.

    Microsoft, Work Trend Index 2023: 31,000 workers in 31 countries

Here is the same day again. This time each chore takes one question, one link, one line or one click.

8:52 AM · Assistant

Ask one question instead of checking two calendars

Your work and personal calendars sit in one week. Ask “Am I free Thursday at 2?”, “Move my 1:1 with Priya to Thursday afternoon” or “Find 30 minutes with Lena and Marco tomorrow”. You get the answer, or the change on your calendar and a short reply saying what changed.

  • Finds time with your guests

    It checks the free time of every guest whose calendar it can see.

  • Many events at once

    Cancel a day's meetings, or update every one that matches, in one message.

  • Focus time and breaks

    Block hours for deep work and add buffers between calls.

  • Knows your week and your calls

    It sees every calendar you show and your meeting notes, and remembers what you tell it.

Start free

The free plan includes 100 assistant chats.

11:30 AM · Booking links

Get booked with one link, not five emails

Share your booking link. People see only the times you're free across every calendar you connect, and pick one. The meeting goes on your calendar, with a Meet or Teams link if you want one. Guests can reschedule or cancel from their confirmation email.

  • Never double-booked

    Every calendar you connect counts as busy, unless you switch it off.

  • Your rules

    Set working hours, minimum notice, buffers and days away.

  • Questions first

    Ask what the meeting is about before they book.

  • On your website

    Embed it inline, as a pop-up or as a button.

1:15 PM · Quick add

Add a meeting in one line, not six fields

Type “Lunch with Marco tomorrow at 1 at Bar Pisacco” and press Enter. The form opens with the day, the time, the place and Marco's invite filled in, ready to send. A clear line with no guests goes straight onto your calendar.

  • Dates, times and repeats

    “Every other Tuesday at 10” makes a repeating meeting.

  • Guests from your contacts

    Names after “with” become invites.

  • Video calls

    “On Meet” adds a Meet link on Google, “on Teams” a Teams link on Microsoft work accounts.

  • Your language

    Type it in Italian, French or another language.

2:58 PM · Web and desktop

Join every call on time, from your menu bar

Install the app on Mac, Windows or Linux and your next meeting sits in your menu bar or system tray. Its reminder opens the call in one click, and one shortcut opens your day from any app. Prefer the browser? Your calendar, the assistant and booking links work there too, with nothing to install.

  • In any browser

    Sign up and start; there is nothing to install.

  • Reminders that open the call

    Join from the reminder with one click.

  • One shortcut

    Open your day from any app with a key press.

  • Always up to date

    The app updates itself in the background.

4:40 PM · Meetings

Never ask “what did we agree?” again

Press Record when the call starts. The desktop app captures your microphone and the call's sound. Soon after you hang up, you have the transcript, a summary by topic and the action items, each with an owner where it's clear.

  • Your voice and theirs

    Records your mic and the call's audio on Mac and Windows.

  • Who said what

    Your lines carry your name, and in a one-to-one call the other person's do too. Rename anyone else.

  • Notes you can act on

    A summary by topic and the action items, ready to check off.

  • Find any meeting

    Search every recorded call, or ask the assistant what was decided.

Start free

Recording and notes are on the paid plans: $49 once or $4.99 a month.

Fast from the keyboard, private by design, and in Claude and ChatGPT

The details you notice on your tenth meeting of the day.

  • Keyboard first

    ⌘K or Ctrl+K goes anywhere, C adds an event, ⌘J or Ctrl+J opens the assistant.

  • Your zone, your week

    Choose your time zone, a 12- or 24-hour clock and the day your week starts.

  • Drag, resize, reply

    Move an event by dragging it, change its length from its edge, and answer invites in place.

  • Private by design

    Your events stay with Google, Microsoft or Apple, and Calendar0 encrypts the keys it holds to each account.

  • Memory you control

    See and delete what the assistant remembers, in Settings.

  • Your week in Claude and ChatGPT

    Connect Claude or ChatGPT and ask them about your week without opening Calendar0.

content_html_zh:
Schedule in seconds. Remember every call.

The calendar that books your meetings and takes notes on your calls

For founders and managers with a work calendar, a personal one and back-to-back calls. See Google, Outlook and iCloud in one week, add a meeting in one line, and get notes from every call you record in the desktop app.

Free plan, no card needed. Works in your browser, or download the app for Mac, Windows and Linux.

Works withGoogle CalendarOutlookiCloud

You spend your day on calendar admin, one small chore at a time

None of it is hard, and none of it is your fault. Your calendars sit in separate apps, so the checking, the typing and the chasing fall to you.

  1. 8:52 AMAre you free Thursday at 2?You check your work calendar, then your personal one, then reply.
  2. 11:30 AMWhen works for you next week?Five emails later, you both settle on Tuesday.
  3. 1:15 PMLunch with Marco, tomorrowTitle, date, start, end, place, guest. Six fields for one lunch.
  4. 2:58 PMYour 3:00 call is about to startYou search your inbox for the link and join late.
  5. 4:40 PMWhat did we agree on the call?Nobody wrote it down, so you ask again.

It isn't just you.

  • 43%of workers surveyed spend at least three hours a week just scheduling meetings.Calendly, The State of Meetings 2024: 1,244 US and UK workers
  • 57%of workers surveyed say it's hard to catch up when they join a meeting late.Microsoft, Work Trend Index 2023: 31,000 workers in 31 countries
  • 55%of workers surveyed say the next steps at the end of a meeting are unclear.Microsoft, Work Trend Index 2023: 31,000 workers in 31 countries

Here is the same day again. This time each chore takes one question, one link, one line or one click.

8:52 AM · Assistant

Ask one question instead of checking two calendars

Your work and personal calendars sit in one week. Ask “Am I free Thursday at 2?”, “Move my 1:1 with Priya to Thursday afternoon” or “Find 30 minutes with Lena and Marco tomorrow”. You get the answer, or the change on your calendar and a short reply saying what changed.

  • Finds time with your guestsIt checks the free time of every guest whose calendar it can see.
  • Many events at onceCancel a day's meetings, or update every one that matches, in one message.
  • Focus time and breaksBlock hours for deep work and add buffers between calls.
  • Knows your week and your callsIt sees every calendar you show and your meeting notes, and remembers what you tell it.

免费开始

The free plan includes 100 assistant chats.

11:30 AM · Booking links

Get booked with one link, not five emails

Share your booking link. People see only the times you're free across every calendar you connect, and pick one. The meeting goes on your calendar, with a Meet or Teams link if you want one. Guests can reschedule or cancel from their confirmation email.

  • Never double-bookedEvery calendar you connect counts as busy, unless you switch it off.
  • Your rulesSet working hours, minimum notice, buffers and days away.
  • Questions firstAsk what the meeting is about before they book.
  • On your websiteEmbed it inline, as a pop-up or as a button.

1:15 PM · Quick add

Add a meeting in one line, not six fields

Type “Lunch with Marco tomorrow at 1 at Bar Pisacco” and press Enter. The form opens with the day, the time, the place and Marco's invite filled in, ready to send. A clear line with no guests goes straight onto your calendar.

  • Dates, times and repeats“Every other Tuesday at 10” makes a repeating meeting.
  • Guests from your contactsNames after “with” become invites.
  • Video calls“On Meet” adds a Meet link on Google, “on Teams” a Teams link on Microsoft work accounts.
  • Your languageType it in Italian, French or another language.

2:58 PM · Web and desktop

Join every call on time, from your menu bar

Install the app on Mac, Windows or Linux and your next meeting sits in your menu bar or system tray. Its reminder opens the call in one click, and one shortcut opens your day from any app. Prefer the browser? Your calendar, the assistant and booking links work there too, with nothing to install.

  • In any browserSign up and start; there is nothing to install.
  • Reminders that open the callJoin from the reminder with one click.
  • One shortcutOpen your day from any app with a key press.
  • Always up to dateThe app updates itself in the background.

4:40 PM · Meetings

Never ask “what did we agree?” again

Press Record when the call starts. The desktop app captures your microphone and the call's sound. Soon after you hang up, you have the transcript, a summary by topic and the action items, each with an owner where it's clear.

  • Your voice and theirsRecords your mic and the call's audio on Mac and Windows.

  • Notes you can act onA summary by topic and the action items, ready to check off.
  • Find any meetingSearch every recorded call, or ask the assistant what was decided.
